question.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x) = P(X \leq x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(4) & =P(X\le 4) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2,3,4\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0\})+P(X\in \{1,2,3,4\}) \\  & =P(X\le 0)+P(1\le X<5) \\  & =F(0)+P(1\le X<5).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(1\le X<5) & =F(4)-F(0) \\  & =0.9163-0.0222 \\  & =0.8941.\end{aligned}
$$
